title: New Leads
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office deals with the distribution and discovery of sales leads, which turn out to be clues in a scavenger hunt. Michael distributes the leads, leading to confusion and conflicts among the staff. Meanwhile, tensions about the sales team and office relationships surface, culminating in humorous and awkward moments at the dump and in the office. The episode explores office dynamics, miscommunications, and developing personal relationships.

main_threads.thread: Michael distributes leads and manages office conflicts over their nature and distribution.
